positives.fix_title: fix(next.config): scope chat-api guard to production builds only
positives.fix_body: ## Summary Hot-fix for a real regression Devin Review flagged on the merged PR #32: my `assertSafeChatApiUrl()` ran unconditionally at config-load time, so it also fired during `next dev` — crashing `pnpm dev` for anyone following the documented local-dev setup. The README explicitly tells developers to set `NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAT_API_URL=http://localhost:8000` in `.env.local` for local development (see `README.md:234`). Combined with my guard, that meant the moment a dev followed the docs, their dev server would refuse to start with a "localhost URL rejected" error. Fix is a one-line gate: ```ts if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "production") assertSafeChatApiUrl(); ``` Next.js automatically sets `NODE_ENV=production` during `next build` and `NODE_ENV=development` during `next dev`, so this is the canonical way to scope to prod builds only. ### Test matrix re-verified locally | NODE_ENV | `NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAT_API_URL` | Expected | Result | |---|---|---|---| | development | `http://localhost:8000` | ALLOW | ALLOWED ✓ (regression fix) | | development | `https://x.trycloudflare.com` | ALLOW | ALLOWED ✓ | | production | `https://x.trycloudflare.com` | REJECT | REJECTED ✓ | | production | `http://localhost:8000` | REJECT | REJECTED ✓ | | production | `` (blank) | ALLOW | ALLOWED ✓ | | production | `https://vexorterminal.com` | ALLOW | ALLOWED ✓ | `npm run build` succeeds with the current blank `.env.local`. `eslint next.config.ts` clean. ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human Risk: green (one-line scope fix; production protection preserved). - [ ] Try `pnpm dev` with `NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAT_API_URL=http://localhost:8000` in `.env.local` — should now start the dev server normally. - [ ] Optionally re-confirm prod build still rejects: temporarily set `.env.local` to `NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAT_API_URL=https://anything.trycloudflare.com` and run `npm run build` — should exit non-zero with the actionable error. ### Notes - Tied to PR #32. That PR is correct in intent; this just narrows when the guard runs. - Devin Review finding citation: `next.config.ts:47`, comment id `3276106590`. - After merge: manual `pnpm build --webpack && npx wrangler deploy` per the usual ritual (Cloudflare auto-deploy still not wired). The previous deploy (`815416ee-59a9-413e-a87c-c2e1f1b14181`, 2026-05-20T18:05:43Z) is already running the unconditional guard but never breaks prod builds because production `.env.local` has the var blank. Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/837064b149764eec8679057bbcb96e7c Requested by: @Vexorterminal0111 ---

positives.fix_body: ## Summary Follow-up to #19 fixing the regression Devin Review caught. **Bug**: once `inferFrequencyFromRange` auto-filled `item.frequency`, subsequent date edits no longer re-triggered inference because the `!item.frequency` guard saw the (now-truthy) pre-update value. A user who entered a 1-year range and later shortened `endDate` to 3 months would still submit a yearly subscription. There was also no way for the user to clear a stuck value back to "auto". **Fix**: stop stamping inferred values onto `item.frequency`. Treat that field as the **manual override only** — keep it empty unless the user explicitly picks something from the dropdown. positives.fix_body:
## Summary

Follow-up cho PR #127 (giftcode revoke ConfirmModal) — sửa regression Devin Review phát hiện: helper `mapGiftcodeRevokeErrorKey` chỉ map riêng `CODE_NOT_FOUND` / `CODE_REVOKED`. Mọi code khác (UNAUTHENTICATED khi session hết hạn, FORBIDDEN khi role bị tước, ADMIN_ONLY khi MOD bấm nhầm, etc.) đều fall through sang `admin.errors.UNKNOWN` ("Có lỗi xảy ra") — admin mất thông tin hữu ích.

Sửa: nếu `mapGiftcodeRevokeErrorKey` trả về `admin.errors.UNKNOWN`, gọi tiếp `handleErr(e)` để route qua dynamic mapper `t('admin.errors.${code}', '__missing__')` — match đúng pattern các action admin khác (grant, ban, approve topup, ...).

### Vì sao hữu ích
- Khôi phục actionable error message cho admin (ví dụ "Hết phiên, hãy đăng nhập lại" cho UNAUTHENTICATED).
- Giữ nguyên 2 mapping đặc biệt cho giftcode (`CODE_NOT_FOUND` / `CODE_REVOKED`) — toast nhẹ, không cần fallback.
- Không thêm dependency, không thêm i18n key, không thêm helper mới.

### Vấn đề giải quyết
Devin Review trên PR #127 (comment ID 3166138114): "Giftcode revoke error handling regresses: auth/permission errors now display generic UNKNOWN message". Sửa đúng theo gợi ý trong comment.

### Rủi ro 🟢 thấp
- Chỉ sửa 7 dòng trong 1 file (AdminView.vue) — `confirmGiftcodeRevoke` catch branch.
- Không touch helper `mapGiftcodeRevokeErrorKey` (vẫn đúng cho 2 case đặc biệt).
- `handleErr` đã được test qua các action admin khác từ trước.

### Rollback
Revert PR.

### Changes

**File sửa**
- `apps/web/src/views/AdminView.vue` — `confirmGiftcodeRevoke` catch branch:
  ```diff
    const code = (e as { code?: string }).code;
    const key = mapGiftcodeRevokeErrorKey(code);
  -  toast.push({ type: 'error', text: t(key) });
  +  if (key === 'admin.errors.UNKNOWN') {
  +    handleErr(e);
  +  } else {
  +    toast.push({ type: 'error', text: t(key) });
  +  }
  ```

### Tests
- `pnpm typecheck` ✅ (3 project)
- `pnpm lint` ✅ (max-warnings 0)
- `pnpm --filter @xuantoi/web test` ✅ **263/263** (32 file).
- Helper `mapGiftcodeRevokeErrorKey` vẫn cover bởi 4 vitest từ PR #127 (CODE_NOT_FOUND / CODE_REVOKED / unknown / undefined+empty).

### `AI_HANDOFF_REPORT.md updated`
Sẽ gom vào PR audit refresh kế tiếp.

## Review & Testing Checklist for Human

- [ ] CI green.
- [ ] Mở admin → Giftcode tab → click "Thu hồi" → modal hiện.
- [ ] Để session hết hạn (xoá cookie hoặc đợi >24h) → click confirm → toast hiển thị "Hết phiên, hãy đăng nhập lại" thay vì "Có lỗi xảy ra".
- [ ] MOD account thử click confirm (nếu có) → toast "Hành động này chỉ ADMIN mới được thực hiện".

### Notes
- Stack: base `main` post-#127 merge. Không phụ thuộc PR khác.
- Devin Review comment: https://github.com/hoathienmenh-01/xuantoi/pull/127#discussion_r3166138114

positives.fix_title: fix(intake-review): don't swallow requireRole's NEXT_REDIRECT in getRoomsForHouse
positives.fix_body: ## Summary Fixes a regression Devin Review flagged on PR #13: the catch-all try/catch I added around `getRoomsForHouse` was also catching the `NEXT_REDIRECT` error that `requireRole("admin")` throws via `next/navigation`'s `redirect()` — silently swallowing the redirect for unauthenticated or non-admin users. Move `requireRole()` and `createAdminClient()` above the try block. The try/catch now only wraps the Supabase DB work, which is what actually needed the error-surfacing behavior. This may also explain why David's `/residents → House 2` still shows the scrubbed "Server Components render" text post-PR-#13: if his admin session had expired, the attempt to redirect him to `/login` was being caught and converted into my "Unexpected error: NEXT_REDIRECT..." string, which Next would then re-wrap as the generic production error. ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human 🟢 Low risk — pure bug fix, restores the standard auth redirect pattern used everywhere else in this file. - [ ] After deploy + hard refresh, retry House 2 on intake review. If the session is valid, you'll now see either a populated dropdown, "No available beds…", or the real DB error. If the session is invalid you'll be redirected to `/login` (correct behavior). - [ ] While logged in as a non-admin manager, try invoking the same action (e.g. visit a URL that would trigger it) — should redirect to `/dashboard` cleanly. ### Notes - Targets `devin/1776361959-polish-v1`. - No behavior change on the happy path. Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/c4cab83a7ba545cb9e5b3f220ac13e1d Requested by: @arborstarjax-bot ---

positives.fix_title: fix: correct Safe count formula + clear completedAt on task status revert (Devin Review #416)
positives.fix_body: # fix: correct Safe count formula + clear completedAt on task status revert ## Summary Addresses 2 bugs identified by Devin Review on PR #416 (Quantum Readiness Assessment): 1. **Safe count formula** (`quantum-readiness.tsx`): The Risk Distribution chart's "Safe" count was `totalAssets - vulnerableAssets - lowRiskCount`, but `vulnerableAssets` only counts quantum-vulnerable assets (RSA/ECDSA/ECDH broken by Shor's). Classically-weak algorithms like 3DES or MD5 have `isQuantumVulnerable: false` but still carry critical/medium risk levels — so they were incorrectly counted as "Safe". Fixed to `totalAssets - criticalRiskCount - highRiskCount - mediumRiskCount - lowRiskCount`. 2. **completedAt not cleared on revert** (`quantum-readiness.ts`): When a migration task's status was changed to "migrated" or "verified", `completedAt` was set. But reverting the status back (e.g. to "in_progress") left the stale `completedAt` timestamp in the DB. Added `else if (updates.status) { updates.completedAt = null; }`. ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human - [ ] Verify the "Safe" count now correctly excludes classically-weak algorithms (e.g. add a 3DES asset — it should NOT appear in the "Safe" bucket) - [ ] Verify reverting a migration task from "verified" → "in_progress" clears the `completedAt` field in the DB ### Notes - No automated tests cover either code path — manual verification recommended - Both fixes match the suggestions from Devin Review exactly --- Link to Devin Session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/3a3986ea2e634738b60723f9edf81e5e Requested by: @prathamesh-ops-sudo ---
